parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing against the specification, every stated value, part and rail matches (XT60-M input, 10 mOhm/2512 shunt R1, MIC26903YJL-TR buck with R5=6k8/R6=1k3 giving ~4.98 V, LD39200PU33R LDO, INA219 at 0x40 with A0/A1 to GND, BMI088 0x19/0x69, IIS2MDCTR 0x1E, MPRLS 0x18 with the documented RESET/EOC swap, TMP100 0x4E, 24CW1280 0x50 on both sides, W25N01GV, H753+F405 MCUs, 25 MHz crystals, TDD01H0SB1R boot switches, CH330 bridges, 0-ohm FCC<->NAVC I2C link). The only apparent mismatch is the PCA9685 address (drawing note 'I2C address: 0x41' with A0 tied to +3.3V, vs spec table 'I2C addr 0x40'); however the drawing places both the PCA9685 and the INA219 on the same I2C2_FCC bus, so 0x40 would be a bus collision and the spec's 0x40 is a transcription error, while the drawing's 0x41 is the only electrically valid value. No deviation supported by the drawing changes the board's behaviour, so the schematic is judged correct.
